errors.says: With the selected bits at a common offset, every transform round is one simultaneous butterfly layer

errors.says: Prefix-slot rounds cost O(Tp) per round and O(TpdK) in total
errors.paper: O(Tp) is the cost of moves and scans for one individually processed bit; with up to D bits per round and at most b+1<=K rounds the total is O(TpdK), so a round costs O(TpD), not O(Tp)

overall.reason: Neither plan has a major error; each has two minor misstatements. On the central chain and core items B carries essential steps A lacks: the complex phase interface P1-P4 and s_c (A only restates the conclusion), the residual table, side edge and F_2 orthonormal bases (L1, L2, L4), the exact deficits eta_b and eta_c and the sigma case, the elimination proof of the triangular factorization, the change-of-basis conjugation in the phase recursion, and the guard-width derivation S1-S4 of the layer. B's chain also derives the saving for both networks where A's thins out on the complex side, and A has nothing that B lacks on any item.
